description: A text/* Content-Type hint's charset replaces encoding detection (tikajs-68os.41): latin1 bytes decode as the hinted charset. Tika 4.2.0 (oracle, PUT /meta Content-Type: text/plain; charset=iso-8859-1) reports windows-1252 (the WHATWG reading of the label) in Content-Encoding and tk:detected-encoding.
